claims.label: Twelve app nodes cover launch peak
claims.detail: The point estimate divides 14.4K peak RPS by a 2K RPS benchmark and adds four nodes.

checks.label: Units cancel correctly
checks.detail: requests/second divided by requests/second per node produces nodes.

checks.label: Utilization is explicit
checks.detail: The claim adds nodes but never states the target utilization used to protect latency.

checks.label: Failure bound is satisfied
checks.detail: At 65% target utilization, 14.4K / (2K x 0.65) already requires 12 nodes before any node loss.

claims.nextMeasurement: Replay the launch request mix at the target p95 latency, then remove one node and repeat the peak interval.
claims.hiddenRisk: The remembered node count confuses spare nodes with utilization headroom.

claims.label: Thirty-day event retention needs 2 TB
claims.detail: The claim assumes 50 million 1 KB events per day and three stored copies.

checks.label: Units cancel correctly
checks.detail: events/day x bytes/event x days x copies produces stored bytes.

checks.label: Independent raw-data bound
checks.detail: 50M x 1 KB x 30 x 3 is about 4.5 TB before indexes, metadata, backups, or compression.

checks.label: Storage modifiers are named
checks.detail: Compression, indexes, compaction, and backup retention are not measured.

claims.nextMeasurement: Measure encoded event size and compression on a representative sample, then add index and backup amplification separately.
claims.hiddenRisk: A plausible-looking point estimate is below the raw replicated lower bound.

claims.label: A 180 ms dependency fits a 200 ms response SLO
claims.detail: The claim compares one dependency p95 with the entire user-facing p95 target.

checks.label: Time units match
checks.detail: Both values are expressed in milliseconds at p95.

checks.label: Critical-path budget closes
checks.detail: Only 20 ms remains for the client, edge, queue, application, serialization, and response transfer.

checks.label: Percentile scope matches
checks.detail: A component p95 does not prove the end-to-end p95, especially under correlated load.

claims.nextMeasurement: Trace the complete request by cohort and assign an explicit dependency deadline from the remaining end-to-end budget.
claims.hiddenRisk: The claim treats a component target as though it were the complete critical path.

evidenceOptions.label: Remembered heuristic
evidenceOptions.detail: No workload-specific observation supports the point estimate.

evidenceOptions.label: Analogous production system
evidenceOptions.detail: A related system supplies evidence, but its mix and constraints differ.

evidenceOptions.label: Representative measurement
evidenceOptions.detail: The target mix, percentile, and failure condition were exercised.

impactOptions.label: Cheap, reversible experiment
impactOptions.detail: A miss can be rolled back without violating a customer or data contract.

impactOptions.label: User-facing SLO commitment
impactOptions.detail: Underestimation creates visible latency, errors, or unplanned scaling work.

impactOptions.label: Durability or correctness boundary
impactOptions.detail: Being wrong can lose data, duplicate effects, or violate an external promise.
